description: This file defines the `PersonMergeLog` class, which represents an audit log for merges of two `Person` objects within the OpenMRS framework. It records the winning and losing persons in the merge, the serialized merge data, and associated metadata, providing mechanisms to track and potentially recover from erroneous merges.

classes.name: PersonMergeLog
classes.description: Represents an audit log entry for merging two Person records, capturing details about the merge event including the involved persons, serialized data, and metadata.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this merge log record.

methods.name: setPersonMergeLogId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this merge log record.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Returns the Person object representing the preferred (winning) person in the merge.

methods.name: setWinner
methods.description: Sets the Person object representing the preferred (winning) person in the merge.

methods.name: getLoser
methods.description: Returns the Person object representing the non-preferred (losing) person in the merge.

methods.name: setLoser
methods.description: Sets the Person object representing the non-preferred (losing) person in the merge.

methods.name: getSerializedMergedData
methods.description: Returns the serialized string containing details of the merge.

methods.name: setSerializedMergedData
methods.description: Sets the serialized string containing details of the merge.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogData
methods.description: Returns the deserialized merge data object.

methods.name: setPersonMergeLogData
methods.description: Sets the deserialized merge data object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the merge log, overriding the method from the parent class.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the merge log, overriding the method from the parent class.
